Dealer Opportunity

A better answer than another standard wheelchair.

Strongback gives dealers a simple, high-impact message: comfort, posture support, folding convenience, premium styling, and a lineup that fits multiple customer needs.

Ergonomic back support

The signature Strongback backrest is designed to support the natural lumbar curve and promote a more upright seated position.

Easy to explain

Customers immediately understand the difference when they compare a flat-back wheelchair to a Strongback ergonomic support system.

Premium showroom story

Strongback creates a higher-value conversation around comfort, posture, transportability, and lifestyle — not just price.

Excursion Transport Chairs

The Premium choice in comfort and Lifestyle

The STRONGBACK Excursion Transport is the first off the-shelf standard folding chair to provide patented posture support and increased comfort. Its unique ergonomic shape promotes healthy upright sitting and ensures comfort from the first moment you sit down.

New: ErgoSteel 18" Wheelchair | $399.99 MSRP

ErgoSteel brings the Strongback comfort story into a high-demand price range.

The new ErgoSteel 18" wheelchair is built to help dealers compete in the everyday wheelchair category while still offering the comfort advantage Strongback is known for.

  • Ergonomic backrest and seat for practical Strongback comfort
  • Robust steel frame for dependable everyday use
  • Compact and foldable design with swing-away/removable legrests
  • 300 lb user capacity with quick-release wheels
  • Positioned to be a market leader in the $399.99 MSRP price range

Give customers a visible comfort comparison.

Strongback is easy to demonstrate because the difference is visual and physical: flat-back seating versus ergonomic lumbar support.

Standard Wheelchair

  • Flat backrest with limited posture support
  • Can encourage a forward, hunched seated position
  • Often sold mainly on price
  • Limited comfort story for retail teams

Strongback Mobility

  • Patented ergonomic backrest supports lumbar curve
  • Promotes a healthier, more upright seated position
  • Creates a premium customer experience
  • Helps dealers sell comfort, differentiation, and value

Service / Warranty

Strongback Consumer Product Claim Form

Strongback Mobility is committed to exceptional customer service, and we want to give our customers the easiest claim process possible. Please submit the form below to begin. Please allow 2-3 business days for your claim process to be reviewed. We kindly ask that you provide all the necessary details from the start, so that we can handle your claim quickly and thoroughly. If you purchased your wheelchair or rollator through a local Dealer, please return to that Dealer and they will submit this form for you. This warranty does NOT apply to used, purchased wheelchairs or rollators, nor does it apply to wheelchairs or rollators that are used as rentals. Please note: Failure to complete the claim form in its entirety will delay or possibly void the claim.

Service / Warranty

Strongback Return Authorization Request

Strongback Mobility is committed to exceptional customer service, and we want to give our customers the easiest return claim process possible. Please submit the form below to begin if you purchased directly from StrongbackMobility.com. Please allow 2-3 business days for your claim process to be reviewed. Return Policy Details: EASY RETURNS If you received a chair that is in perfect condition but want to return it for a different reason you have a full 30 days to do so. In these instances, you will need to pay for return shipping and submit the form below to request a return authorization. Any returns received in our warehouse without an issued return authorization will be ineligible for a refund and will be returned to you at your expense. REQUEST A RETURN AUTHORIZATION Strongback Mobility is committed to exceptional customer service and we want to give our customers the easiest return process possible. Please submit the form below to request a return authorization. Once we have received your request, we will send you a confirmation email with your return authorization number (which must be included with your wheelchair to return) and the address where you can mail your returned item. PLEASE NOTE Returns submitted more than 30 days after delivery will not be authorized for return. Products must be returned in their original packaging, and have no cracks, scratches, or any indications of use. A return authorization must be requested and the return authorization number must be included with your return. Customer is responsible for return shipping costs.
